register.labelZh: SLAP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: slap something on 可以表示迅速塗上化妝品、藥膏或油漆,也可以表示快速貼上標籤。；slap somebody down 可以描述某人在表達意見時遭到強硬制止或駁回。；法庭、學校及其他機構可以向個人或團體施加罰款、禁令或限制。；slap 某個金額 on a price 通常表示價格突然上升,而且加幅可能令人不滿或感到意外。；slap somebody about 或 around 表示暴力行為;slap somebody down 則表示言語上強硬地壓制某人。
register.summaryEn: Slap something on can describe quickly applying make-up, cream, paint or a label. Slap somebody down describes a situation in which someone is sharply stopped or dismissed while expressing an opinion. Courts, schools and other organisations may slap fines, bans or restrictions on people or groups. Slap an amount on a price often suggests that the increase is quick, unwelcome or surprisingly large. Slap somebody about or around refers to violence, while slap somebody down refers to forceful verbal treatment.
